treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark and the Government of the Hellenic Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1989)
eif_quote: Overenskomsten trådte i medfør af artikel 29 i kraft den 18. januar 1992.
source_title: BKI nr 41 af 30/04/1992 (Danish translation; authentic text English only)

rates.quote: a) 38 pct. af bruttobeløbet af udbyttet, hvis det udloddende selskab er hjemmehørende i Grækenland, og
b) 18 pct. af bruttobeløbet af udbyttet, hvis det udloddende selskab er hjemmehørende i Danmark.

2. Sådanne renter kan imidlertid også beskattes i den kontraherende stat, hvorfra de hidrører, og i overensstemmelse med lovgivningen i denne stat, men den skat der pålignes må, såfremt modtageren er renternes retmæssige ejer, ikke overstige 8 pct. af bruttobeløbet af renterne.

2. Sådanne royalties kan imidlertid også beskattes i den kontraherende stat, hvorfra de hidrører, og i overensstemmelse med lovgivningen i denne stat, men den skat der pålignes må, såfremt modtageren er royaltybeløbets retmæssige ejer, ikke overstige 5 pct. af royalty-bruttobeløbet.

ppt.quote: 1. Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Convention signed in English only ('i to eksemplarer på engelsk'); quotes are from the official Danish translation in the bekendtgørelse - English original not fetched. Art. 29(2): effect for income derived in the calendar year following the year of the last notification (EIF 1992-01-18) -> 1993-01-01. Dividend caps are asymmetric and not ownership-dependent: Greece as source 38% (above the validator's 35% range but as written in the treaty), Denmark as source 18%. Protocol: container leasing payments treated as leasing of industrial equipment under art. 12(3). MLI: covered by both; WHT effective date 2022-01-01 (treaty map). MLI art. 8 not relevant/does not apply (Greece reserved the entirety of art. 8; treaty has no ownership-threshold tier). No art. 35(7) reservation.
